4f31a6552972d4d35980f3438375d351.overview: Connie, the fifteen-year-old black sheep of her family, finds her summertime idyll of beach trips, mall hangouts, and innocent flirtations shattered by an encounter with a mysterious stranger.

4f4d4a3fe1ce09ecef1d19a3ffc8b887.overview: In the not so distant future, Theodore, a lonely writer, purchases a newly developed operating system designed to meet the user's every need. To Theodore's surprise, a romantic relationship develops between him and his operating system. This unconventional love story blends science fiction and romance in a sweet tale that explores the nature of love and the ways that technology isolates and connects us all.

4f8ec4d9ea682389d85fbf8dc1f20984.overview: A French housekeeper with a mysterious past brings quiet revolution in the form of one exquisite meal to a circle of starkly pious villagers in late 19th century Denmark.
4f8ec4d9ea682389d85fbf8dc1f20984.tagline: Artistic, sensual and sacred passions unite in Babette's Feast.

4faa0be48ae1e59ac25fbc92c315a41f.overview: Opposites attract when, during their college days, Katie Morosky, a politically active Jew, meets Hubbell Gardiner, a feckless WASP. Years later, in the wake of World War II, they meet once again and, despite their obvious differences, attempt to make their love for each other work.
4faa0be48ae1e59ac25fbc92c315a41f.tagline: Everything seemed so important then... even love!

4fb89541725e1e133b410eddb2a1242d.overview: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.
4fb89541725e1e133b410eddb2a1242d.tagline: There is enchantment in the light.

4fc4763de20994e26b52f6030907e878.overview: An illegal Chinese immigrant falls behind on payments on an enormous smuggling debt. Ming Ding has only until the end of the day to come up with the money.
4fc4763de20994e26b52f6030907e878.tagline: One illegal immigrant, one smuggling debt, one day to pay up.

4fdab99c451f805e3cd79da015d6bde8.overview: 'Lonny' is a scripted reality drama that centers around Lonny, a twenty-something, as he meanders through his hipster existence desperately trying to meet girls. Next Time On Lonny, things get interesting... very interesting.

4fe572802332c9123082405eda4b81e1.overview: With the help of government-issued pamphlets, an elderly British couple build a shelter and prepare for an impending nuclear attack, unaware that times and the nature of war have changed from their romantic memories of World War II.

4ff97b90adfa1a04f39bc3c808f49fdd.overview: Drunk and disillusioned Roman, Marcellus Gallio, wins Jesus' robe in a dice game after the crucifixion. Marcellus has never been a man of faith like his slave, Demetrius, but when Demetrius escapes with the robe, Marcellus experiences disturbing visions and feels guilty for his actions. Convinced that destroying the robe will cure him, Marcellus sets out to find Demetrius — and discovers his Christian faith along the way.
4ff97b90adfa1a04f39bc3c808f49fdd.tagline: The first motion picture in CinemaScope--the modern miracle you see without glasses!
